notes: First section of the script: three PROC LOGISTIC variants (default logit, link=probit, link=cloglog) predicting good_bad from age/amount/duration/checking/savings on the German-credit-style 'applicants' data. Original reads libname mydata pointing at the author's local disk; substituted with a 41-row inline DATALINES sample matching the same column shapes (checking/savings as A1x/A6x categorical status codes) so the CLASS/MODEL logic runs unmodified. Sample sized/balanced to avoid quasi-complete separation warnings seen with a smaller draft.
